marathon.name: Princess
marathon.bio: Hi humans! My name is Princess. I thought I had a forever home but it just wouldn't stick so I'm back in these kennels once again. Here's what you should know- I'm a sweet and playful girl who deserves the forever kind of love. It's looking like I'll be happiest as the only dog in the home and the jury is still out when it comes to me having any future friendships with cats. I think we'll have to learn the rest about each other as we go- are you in?!

marathon.name: Puck
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Puck and boy am I ready to be adopted. You see when I first got to the HSMC I was scared, alone and so afraid of everything. Over time I've really blossomed into my true self. I'm a very sweet boy that loves to be pet and go exploring. If you think a cool cat like me could be the one for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Ivy
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Ivy! I'm a fun loving girl that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I'm very playful, adorable and ready to be YOURS! Come see me soon!*Ivy is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Ivy please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Ryn
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Ryn! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I'm a very loving girl but I can be a little shy with new people. Not much is known about me before I came to HSMC as I was a stray but staff do know I have a rather unique look to me. As you can tell, one of my pupils are very different than the other. Don't worry though, I'm still very active, playful and loving! It doesn't change a single thing about me. If you think I could be the gal for you come visit me soon!*Ryn is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Ryn please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visitLess

marathon.name: Klaus *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Klaus! I'm a happy guy that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to go mousing!

marathon.name: Pepper
marathon.bio: Aren't I just the cutest boy you have ever seen?! My name is Pepper and I can't wait to fall in love with you. I came to the shelter from a multi-cat household and wouldn't mind having a feline friend (or two) in my next home. I'm shy but trying my best to be brave; please go slow and be patient on our first meeting. I have so much potential, I hope you give me a chance to show you.

marathon.name: Astronomer *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Astronomer and I'm ready to be your new mouser! Come adopt me soon!

marathon.name: Old Mother Hubbard *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: I'm a resourceful and independent girlie who prefers a life wild and free. I'd be the perfect guest for your barn or shed and will keep your rodent population at bay!

marathon.name: Bluey
marathon.bio: My name is Bluey! I am here with my 2 friends. A wonderful family helped us out of a situation and now we are ready for our forever home together. Our ages and history are unknown. It's all okay though, the future is bright and that is what we are looking forward to! Is your home too quiet? We can help! We like to make noise whether we are singing ourselves or making music with our toys. Come and meet us!

marathon.name: Penny
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Penny! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I've lived with other cats before and done well, so I will likely do so again! I'm very outgoing and sweet, so I know you will just love me! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Argus *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: My name is Argus and I'm a working cat. You won't find me cuddled up on the couch with the family, I'll be at the edge of the shadows practicing my independence and keeping the rodent population under control. The best part? You can pay me in the form of food, water and shelter.

marathon.name: Lily
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Lily! I'm a sweet gal that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I was found wandering the fields with three friends of mine and were rescued by a kind family that helped me. But, after escaping a few times and thinking that chickens were yummy it was decided my previous owners weren't coming forward and it was time for me to find a new place to call home, so here I am! I'm a very loving girl and I love snuggles and being around people. If you think I could be the sweetheart for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Chef
marathon.bio: Chef here, what's your name? I'm hoping you have all of the ingredients to make your house my forever home. The recipe is simple: clean water, a balanced diet and a roof over my head with a dash of adventure, a sprinkle of direction and a heavy pour of TLC. Think you can keep up in the kitchen? Let's get our aprons on and get started!

marathon.name: Sauce
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Sauce! I'm a fun loving feline that is looking for her new home. I'm super fun loving, energetic and ready to be yours! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Morse
marathon.bio: .... . .-.. .-.. --- (that is Hello in Morse code). My name is Morse and I would be happy to pause my kitten shenanigans to learn a new line of communication with you like morse code. ... . . / -.-- --- ..- / ... --- --- -. (See you soon)

marathon.name: Louie
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Louie! I'm a sweet boy that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call my own. I'm a great cat that has lived with other cats before and done well. I play lots with my toys and would love an active, playful family! Come visit me soon!*Louie is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Louie please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Verdi
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Verdi! I'm a fun loving lady that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home, and let me tell you - I'm a little picky! I'm a diva, and I'm not afraid to say it. I'm not a big fan of being picked up or held, but will curl up in your lap on my own terms - I just like to be in charge. I love to be spoiled and would be best as an only pet. If you think I could be the diva of my dreams then come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Angel Eyes
marathon.bio: Look into my Angel Eyes, and I'll lull you into loving me. I'm a fun loving guy that is playful, snuggly and oh so fun! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Grimm
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Grimm! I'm a handsome fella that was returned to HSMC after my owner was moving and couldn't take me with them. I'm a mellow guy that likes to lounge in the sun and to eat lots of yummy snacks! I'm not a big fan of being picked up, but that's okay! I'll happily hang out with you anyways! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Mailbox *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Ready to send a love letter to your next barn cat? Well, I'm Mailbox and I'm ready to catch all of your mice!

marathon.name: Khajit
marathon.bio: Khajit here, reporting for duty! I'm up to the task of being your new cat and am purring just thinking about the possibility. I'm sweet, soft and curious, too! I came to the shelter as a stray so not much is known about my past but I'm betting I can have a beautiful future with you.

marathon.name: Til
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Til! I'm a handsome feline that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I'm a very outgoing cat that loves people and would be an excellent fit in any home! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Ruby
marathon.bio: The world can be a big and scary place, especially for a nervous girl like me. My name is Ruby and I'm looking for an adult only home where I can be the only pet; I know that makes things complicated as most households have children or other pets, but I've got a feeling that the right person is out there for me, somewhere. I'm a smart girl (too smart for my own good sometimes) and I don't give my heart away easily but once you have it, it will be yours forever. I'd love for you to talk to staff about my past life and what I'm looking for in my future and maybe, if things go right, the things we need are one and the same.

marathon.name: Imani
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Imani! I was a shy little lady but now I'm here at HSMC and ready to brighten up my new home! I'm super playful, adorable and oh so ready to be YOURS! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Atticus
marathon.bio: Howdy partners! My name is Atticus and I am excited about EVERYTHING! I've got a lot of laughs and energy to share so hold on tight and let's goooo! Dog friends are a must have in my book, as are belly rubs, sunshine and Pup-Peroni treats. I can't wait to be best friends!

marathon.name: Mr Winkles
marathon.bio: My name is Mr Winkles and I'm a country boy, just looking to live a life I can be proud of. In the life I used to live, I wasn't used to confined spaces or having to meet new people; trust me when I say I've had to put my big boy pants on since arriving at the shelter. I'm looking for a human who can help build my confidence and learn to be the best dog that I can be. I'm happy around other dogs but can be a little intense so finding a canine companion to balance my vibe would be ideal. I don't think I'd be the right fit for a home with small children. I'm just looking for consistency, companionship and mutual adoration- aren't you?

marathon.name: Jensen
marathon.bio: Ready, set, LET'S PLAY! My name is Jensen and I'm a good time dog. I'm a big fan of mischief and causing a ruckus; you only live once! I LOVE to play with other dogs and think cats are fun, too! I'm looking for my life's greatest adventure and hoping it looks a lot like you. See you soon?!

marathon.name: Ginny
marathon.bio: Hello there, my name is Ginny. My namesake might be good at bat bogey hexes, but I am more of a lover than a fighter. Come down and meet me, you won't need a bottle of Amortencia to fall in love with me. I just need a bit of your patience to let me warm up to you. I will be waiting at the shelter to meet you.

marathon.name: Garfield
marathon.bio: Hello, my name is Garfield. I don't know yet if I like lasagna but I can tell you I like chin scritches and being brushed. I am a quite guy with one of those faces you just have to love. Come down and let's explore the lasagna, or maybe just some cat kibble, together.

marathon.name: Pontoon
marathon.bio: Makin' waves and catchin' rays on the pontoon is what summer is all about. My name is Pontoon and I'm ready to party and we can go to the lake or we can just stay home- it really won't matter as long as I'm with Y-O-U! I'm playful and fun, no matter the season and sure to be the best cat you've ever adopted. See you soon?!

marathon.name: Storybook
marathon.bio: My name is Storybook. My tail might be short (like actually) but I would love to tell you all about my life. Do you think you could write it down for me? I love to talk and tell my stories but I don't have thumbs to write them down. I am sweet and chatty. Come down so we can start our next chapter together.

marathon.name: PB
marathon.bio: Hi there, my name is PB. I might have started out as a cat that was in a barn but I am ready to live the good life in a home with you. I am very sweet and would love to follow you around the house, chatting and getting attention from you any chance I get. Come down to the shelter and meet me.

marathon.name: Knox
marathon.bio: All around me are dogs who are at different stages of acclimating to shelter life; some are brave and make it look easy and some are just trying to right the world that has been turned upside down. Here's the thing, I'm having a hard time. The people I used to love, the dog I used to be, the life I used to know; all of that's gone and I've had to start over new. I tell you this so that you know to take things slow and give me grace when we meet; I've never had to do this before. I'm a loyal and independent girl who would prefer to be the only pet in a quiet household. I need only a few things but very consistently; food/water, love and exercise. Maybe you too have been through a difficult time and felt misunderstood? I'm hoping you're the person who can give me everything that I need and that I may return the favor, too.Less

marathon.name: Basil *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Basil! I'm a great mouser looking for a new home! Come adopt me soon!

marathon.name: Alvida
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Alvida! I'm a sweet little lady that is here at HSMC looking for a new place call home. I'm a super loving cat that is looking for a new lease on life in an indoor home. I love to be pet and I especially loves snacks of any kind! I've been around other cats before and done well, so I think I would do so again! If you think I could be the cat for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Whitey
marathon.bio: My name is Whitey! I am here with my 2 friends. A wonderful family helped us out of a situation and now we are ready for our forever home together. Our ages and history are unknown. It's all okay though, the future is bright and that is what we are looking forward to! Is your home too quiet? We can help! We like to make noise whether we are singing ourselves or making music with our toys. Come and meet us!

marathon.name: Rufus
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Rufus! I'm a happy go lucky guy that wandered my way to HSMC as a stray. I'm a sweet boy that loves everyone I meet and that includes other dogs! I would love a family that loves to go on walks or runs, camping, hiking, swimming, or whatever! I just want a family! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Van Der Linde
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Van Der Linde and boy let me tell you do I have a plan. I have a plan to be adopted and to live out my years with a family that will love me forever. I'm a happy guy that doesn't ask for much and will fit seamlessly into your life. You better come adopt me today!

marathon.name: Boombox
marathon.bio: Hiya, I'm Boombox and I'm ready to rock your world! I'm a playful guy that loves other cats, kids and even dogs! I'm super outgoing and goofy so I know you will just love me! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Galaxy *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: My name is Galaxy and I want to be as untamed and free as the universe itself. I'm used to a life on the streets taking care of me, myself and I. I'd be happy to be your barn or shop cat if you'll have me!

marathon.name: Roo
marathon.bio: Hiya! I'm Roo! I'm a handsome fella here at HSMC who is looking for my forever home! I'm super adorable, purrfect and 100 percent ready to be yours! I would do great in a home with other cats and really can't wait for you to adopt me! Come see me soon!

marathon.name: Podcast
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Podcast! I'm a fun loving guy that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call my home! I'm active, playful and oh so ready for you to adopt me! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Chiquitita
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Chiquitita and I'm ready to sing my way into your heart! I'm a sweeet little lady that is super playful, loving and oh so cute! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Julienne
marathon.bio: Woof! My name is Julienne and my love for you will be as classic and precise as the cut I'm named after. It's hard to believe a cute girl like me ended up in a kennel at the shelter with no place to call home, but I digress. I'm a pint sized pup who is social with other dogs, tolerant of cats and ready to start living life. I tend to be shy on first meeting but you'll know you've won me over when I start to be myself around you, and there's no going back after that.

marathon.name: Goyle
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Goyle! I'm the most loyal guy that is here at HSMC looking for a new home! I'm a handsome guy that is super sweet and outgoing. I'd be a great fit with other cats so you know I'm just purrfect! I'm good looking, playful and ready to be YOURS!

marathon.name: Magnet
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Magnet and boy am I hoping to attract my new family to find me! I'm a sweet boy that can be quite shy until you get to know, but with time we will be the best of friends! Come see me soon!

marathon.name: Terracotta
marathon.bio: HI there, I'm Terracotta! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC as a stray. I'm a great cat that loves attention but can be a little shy until I get to know you! Come visit me soon!*Terracotta is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Terracotta please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Greeney
marathon.bio: My name is Greeney! I am here with my 2 friends. A wonderful family helped us out of a situation and now we are ready for our forever home together. Our ages and history are unknown. It's all okay though, the future is bright and that is what we are looking forward to! Is your home too quiet? We can help! We like to make noise whether we are singing ourselves or making music with our toys. Come and meet us!

marathon.name: Sassy
marathon.bio: Where are all of my strong, independent girlies at? My name is Sassy and it fits; I like to keep my inner circle small and would prefer to be your one and only. I've had my fair share of homes and transitions so I'm hoping to find the one that sticks. Adventurous adults are my vibe, small children or dogs that share my home not so much. I know my forever is out there and I just can't wait to find it.

marathon.name: Jiko
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Jiko! I'm a fun loving cat that is hoping you will come to adopt me! I'm a playful fella that loves people and would make an excellent snuggler! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Pie Crust
marathon.bio: They named me Pie Crust, can you believe that? I guess they're willing to do whatever it takes to help a guy stand out from the crowd! And contrary to popular belief, I'm living proof that the crust is actually the best part. I'm a sweet and handsome fella who can't wait to find a family to love. I'm playful and kind with a little bit of a wild streak. I'm also quite chatty and basically perfect. I'll be waiting!

marathon.name: Plant Stand *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: They call me Plant Stand because I'm multi-purpose and sturdy, ready to get the job done. I was born outside and intended to stay there until I was caught in a live trap and brought to the shelter. I long to get back to the great outdoors where I can hunt and be free. I'd be happy to be your shop or barn cat and will even work for free!

marathon.name: 8-Track
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm 8-Track and I'm purrsitively adorable! I'm a fun loving guy that is great with other cats, dogs and kids! If you're looking for a playful cat than I am the guy for you! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Florean
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Florean! I'm a handsome guy that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I arrived to the shelter as a stray but I'm ready to leave with my new family! I'm outgoing, soft and ready to be YOURS!

marathon.name: Ludwig
marathon.bio: HI there, I'm Ludwig and boy am I ready to go home with you! I'm a handsome guy that came to HSMC as a stray. I'm very friendly and outgoing so I know you will just love me! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Dancing Queen
marathon.bio: Meow there, I'm Dancing Queen and I'm sure to make sure that all of the attention is on ME! I may only be a few months old, but I know how to dance and meow my way into your heart! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Blu
marathon.bio: My name is Blu and I'm looking for a fresh start. My life has taken some unexpected turns and I'm in the camp that says it's about the destination and not journey. Here's to hoping that all of the roads I've traveled thus far will lead me straight to you. I'm a smart and confident guy who is selective when it comes to other dogs and should not be placed with small dogs or cats. I know a handful of tricks that I'll gladly show you in exchange for a treat and I'm looking forward to the long walks and talks we'll share. I can't wait to love everything about you.

marathon.name: Vinyl Record
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Vinyl Record! I'm ready to spin my way into your heart! I'm a fun loving kitten that is ready to find my new home! I'm super great with other cats, kids and dogs so I'll be a wonderful addition to any home! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Valentine
marathon.bio: My name is Valentine and I am not a cat for the faint of heart. I've got high energy and intelligence and am sure to keep you on your toes. Staff think I could be a Savannah mix but I arrived to the shelter as a stray with no one to tell my story. I'm not your typical housecat and I'm not looking to be abandoned again so only serious applicants need apply.

marathon.name: Jake 2
marathon.bio: They call me Jake 2 and if you ask me, I'm the one you should adopt! I'm a shy guy but this tough exterior melts quickly once I get to know you. I'm happiest in the company of other cats and am used to an adult only home but am open to exploring other options. Come on in, we'll talk about it.*Jake 2 is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Jake 2 please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Corwyn
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Corwyn! I'm a happy guy that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call home. I'm a friendly guy that loves people, snacks and getting lots of love! I'm super ready to be adopted so come visit me soon!*Corwyn is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Corwyn please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Air Fryer
marathon.bio: I came to HSMC as a very shy girl. It has taken me a long time to come out of my shell, but I have and I am now ready to make new friend and find my for human(s). I am still shy, but I am sweet. I do love attention and I enjoy playing with toys. I will do best in a calmer environment without young children. Do you think you have room in your heart for a girl like me?*Air Fryer is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Air Fryer please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Astrology *Barn Cat*
marathon.bio: Looking for a good mouser? Well, your stars are in alignment because I'm the best mouser here!

marathon.name: Promise
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Promise and boy do I promise to the best kitty ever! I'm a sweet girl that came to HSMC as a stray but now I'm ready to find my forever home. I'm a lovely gal that loves attention and being around people. I'm a unique coloring, so everyone you bring over will be asking about me! Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Cassiopeia
marathon.bio: Hi there, are you ready to traverse the universe with your new best friend (me!)? Well, I hope so! I'm Cassiopeia and I'm a gorgeous girl looking for a new place to land my spaceship. I'm a happy cat that loves everyone so I know we will be friends! I'm pretty out of this world, so you better come adopt me soon!

marathon.name: Misa
marathon.bio: You look like someone who likes to have FUN and well, that's one thing we already have in common! My name is Misa and I'm looking for a place to call home and a family to love. I'm a high energy girl who is ready to take the world by storm. I'm selective when it comes to other dogs (but my bestie Remi is here and I like her) and may be a bit much for a home with cats. I love feeling the fresh air in my fur and having my favorite human at my side. See you soon?

marathon.name: Chewy
marathon.bio: Hey friends! They call me Chewy and tell me that I'm a good boy and I'm sure hoping that you feel the same way, too. I've got beautiful blue eyes, a stubborn streak and the smarts and wit common to my breed. I enjoy spending time outside, playing fetch and singing the songs of my people. I'm tolerant of other dogs but do not want to share treats or high value items. You look like you could be a forever kind of human, let's make my dreams come true!

marathon.name: Siridean
marathon.bio: Hi there, I'm Siridean! I'm a sweet girl that made her way to HSMC as a stray. But, I know I'll soon be leaving with my forever family! I'm petite, adorable and ready to move in with you! Come visit me soon!*Siridean is currently being fostered at the Starry Night Cat Cafe in Stevens Point. For more information on meeting with Siridean please visit https://www.starrynightcatcafe.com/visit

marathon.name: Marston
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Marston! I'm a friendly fella that is in need of a place to call home. I used to run the streets with a gang of other cats, but now I'm ready to settle down and find my true calling with my forever family. I'm a loving guy that loves people and that just can't wait to find a home. Come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Peeves
marathon.bio: Hey there, I'm Peeves and I'm ready to turn your life upside down! I'm an adventurous, playful and mischievous cat that can't wait to bring some joy into your life! If I could be the one for you come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Trawler
marathon.bio: My name is Trawler and I'm ready to cruise, are you ready to come along for the ride? I'm a sweet and playful kitten; the best in the litter if you ask me (just don't tell my siblings I said so)! I'm full of energy, always purring and ready to play. I can't wait for our maiden journey together!

marathon.name: Yacht
marathon.bio: Come aboard and experience a life of luxury with ME, Yacht! I'm part of the boat litter and I cruised my way to HSMC with my siblings in search of a better life. I can't wait to set sail with a human like you and enjoy all that life has to offer. I'm playful, cuddly and so cute- you can't go wrong with a guy like me!

marathon.name: Graham Bell
marathon.bio: Ring, ring, ring this is Graham Bell calling with your wake up call. It is time for you to come down to the shelter and visit with me. I am ready to play and put you as a favorite in my contact list.

marathon.name: CD
marathon.bio: Hiya, are you ready to find your new favorite record? Well, I'm CD and I'm here to wow you! I'm an adorable kitten that is so playful, snuggly and just generally puuuuuurrfect! I'm great with other cats, kids and dogs so you better come visit me soon!

marathon.name: Mamma Mia
marathon.bio: Mamma Mia, and here I go again! I'm a sweet girl that is here at HSMC looking for a new place to call my home. I'm a sweet girl that loves everyone and just can't wait to find my new family! I'm so loving and sweet I just know you will love me~

clark.name: Missy (Adoption Fee Sponsored!)
clark.bio: Meet Missy! Missy came to CCHS as a stray a couple of times in November, and after being reclaimed the first time, her owners decided to not reclaim her when she came in the second time after multiple attempts to contact them. This sweet girl is about 5 years and 8 months old and weighs roughly 42.4lbs currently. Missy is a total baby! She may have some scars, but we assure you this sweet girl is nothing but smiles and tail wags when it comes to being loved on! We can't guarantee perfection as this big baby as seen some things, but with a gentle hand and a bit of patience we can guarantee undying love and loyalty! Missy has been known to do well with other dogs but will need a meet and greets on site to make sure the pups approve of each other before making that journey home. We aren't entirely certain what her exact breed makeup is, but we can tell you she is 100% Snuggable House Hippo! With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Apply for Missy today! Missy's adoption fee is sponsored by an anonymous donor.

clark.name: Bart
clark.bio: Ay Caramba! Bart is stealing hearts again! Bart came to CCHS with his 7 siblings towards the very end of December from a local farm, and is now the last of the bunch looking for his furever home. This lively Heeler mix is about 6 months old and weighs roughly 24lbs currently. Bart is such a goofball! He can be a little awkward in his approach but he's hoping his adorable looks can distract you from that! While we aren't entirely certain what his exact breed makeup is, we can tell you he is 100% North American Look-at-Dem-Ears! He is all sweetness, cudles, and "please let me sit in your lap for the rest of forever" energy. His hobbies include: following you around, being as close to you as possible, turning into a 24 ib lap dog, looking at you like you hung the moon. he just wants a person to love and call his own. With any puppy, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success to the pup. Apply for Bart today!

clark.name: Darla (Adoption Fee Sponsored!)
clark.bio: Meet Darla! Darla came to CCHS as a stray from the township of Fremont earlier this January. This pretty Red Heeler is about a year and a half old and weighs roughly 35.2lbs currently. Darla is an absolute ray of awkward sunshine! She is such a smart gal but didn't quite grasp onto the social skills so she hopes you can look past her being a bit forward with her affection! Darla is a tad protective of her food, so she'd prefer being the only dog in the home to avoid her anxiety around sharing. With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Apply for Darla today! Darla's adoption fee is sponsored by an anonymous donor!

clark.name: Patty (Adoption fee sponsored)
clark.bio: Meet Patty! Patty came to CCHS with her 4 kittens towards the beginning of March as strays from the Greenwood area. This quirky Tabby is about a year old and weighs roughly 7lbs currently. Patty is a bit of an odd gal! She always looks so surprised with her big eyes! If you're looking for a cat that will have you second guessing your every move with a side eye, Patty is the one for you! Her interesting aura will draw you in and have you both in awe and mild confusion as to how you ended up with such a goofy cat! Apply for Patty today! Adoption fee sponsored by an anonymous donor.

clark.name: Smokey (Bonded with Venus)
clark.bio: Meet Smokey! Smokey came to CCHS as an owner surrender with 2 other cats after their owner decided that their home was no longer the safest place for them. This handsome guy is about 4 and a half years old and weighs roughly 12.1lbs currently. Smokey is a bit of a bashful boy! He has the most gorgeous blue eyes, but it takes a few pats before he'll around and bat them at you! Smokey has a very friendly demeanor, so while he doesn't always seek out affection first, he'll never turn it away! Smokey is currently residing in our Kitty City with a multitude of other feline friends. Apply for Smokey today!

clark.name: Venus (Bonded with Smokey)
clark.bio: Meet Venus! Venus came to CCHS as an owner surrender with 2 other cats after their owner decided that their home was no longer the safest place for them. This beautiful gal is about 4 and a half years old and weighs roughly 9lbs currently. Venus is a bit of a sheepish gal! She has been a little stressed since getting to the shelter and has taken to self-regulating herself in Kitty City. However, once you find her hideout she is more than happy to welcome the attention! Venus would benefit from a furever family that understands that she will need a little time for her personality to blossom. Venus is currently residing in our Kitty City with a multitude of other feline friends. Apply for Venus today!

clark.name: Tiny
clark.bio: Meet Tiny! Tiny came to CCHS as an owner surrender, previously set to be a barn cat however a little bit of wobble in her step had the owner bringing her over to us. This itty-bitty bashful gal is about 11 months old and weighs roughly 4.4lbs currently. Tiny is a sweet gal who is just a little unsure of things! She wasn't given a lot of socialization so she is the teeniest timid, but one thing for certain is that she looooves affection! She does not always know how to ask for it, but with a gentle touch and a little patience, she's very easy to win over. Tiny currently resides in our Kitty City with a number of other feline friends. Apply for Tiny today!

clark.name: Ella
clark.bio: Meet Ella! Ella came to CCHS as a stray from the Sherwood township area earlier this April. This gorgeous gal is about 5 years old and weighs roughly 59.8lbs currently. Ella is such a well-behaved lovergirl! She is all smiles all the time and absolutely loves to steal kisses whenever she can! We don't know terribly much about her past, but we can tell you she is looking towards the future with the same brightness we see in her eyes every day! While we aren't entirely certain what her exact breed makeup is, we can tell you she is 100% Happy to be Involved! With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the pup. Apply for Ella today!

clark.name: Kiara
clark.bio: Meet Kiara! Kiara came to CCHS as a medical transfer from another humane society after her ears developed some pretty nasty infections and needed more in-depth care. This beautiful Mixed Breed is about 7 years old and weighs roughly 76.2lbs currently. Kiara is a delightfully sweet senior that is ready for a furever family of her own to live out the rest of her days with! With Kiara's ears needing some extra tending to, it is important for her to go home with a family who will stay vigilant in keeping her happy and healthy through the rest of her life. While we don't know much about this darling gal, even her breed makeup stays a mystery, we can tell you she is 100% Mayor of Snuggle City! With any rescue, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the pup. Apply for Kiara today!

clark.name: Iris
clark.bio: Meet Iris! Iris came to CCHS from a local farm earlier in May. Iris is one beautiful girl! She has a fluffy black coat with a little white and very perky ears! She is a Border Collie mix and weighs 35.6#. She is about 11 months old (estimated DOB 5/31/25). As would be expected with a Border Collie Iris is a very high energy girl. She walks well on a leash and loves her toys! She is a happy girl, as you can tell from all the smiles in her pictures. Iris will do best with an active family with lots going on to keep her busy and burn off some of that energy. With any dog, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the pup. Apply for Iris today!

clark.name: Connie
clark.bio: meet Connie! Connie came to CCHS due to no fault of her own, her owner abandoned her in a basement of a previous home. Connie is a beautiful coonhound. She is 4 years old and weighs 72.2#. She is tan/brown and silver in color. She will do best with someone/a family with a lot of patience and love who are willing to give her time to learn and adjust. With any dog, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Connie can't wait to meet her new family and get all the love she deserves. Apply today!

clark.name: Florence
clark.bio: Meet Florence. Florence. Florence came to us as an abandoned stray, she was pregnant when she came in. She currently weighs 5# She has had her babies and nurtured them enough to leave the nest, and now its her time to be loved and doted on! Florence is willing to accept all the back and cheek rubs offered. She is ready to become your newest addition and be the baby for a change. Apply today to show her some love!

clark.name: Reyn
clark.bio: Reyn came to CCHS due to no fault of her own, she was abandoned in a basement. Reyn is a coonhound with short brindle fur. She will do best in a family with a lot of patience and love who are willing to give her love and time to learn and adjust. With any dog, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Reyn can't wait to meet her new family. Apply today!

clark.name: Nana
clark.bio: Nana came to CCHS due to being abandoned in a basement. Nana is a Aussie mix. She is 4 years old and weighs 64.8#. She has short brown/tan fur. She will do best in a family with a lot of patience and love who are willing to give her time to learn and adjust. With any dog, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Nana can't wait to meet her new family. Apply today!

clark.name: Savannah (Adoption fee sponsored)
clark.bio: Savannah came to CCHS due to no fault of her own. Savannah is an Australian shepherd. She has long reddish brown and white fur. She weighs 60# She is very enthusiastic and looking for someone to match, she has a lot of love to give, and wants to make sure you know it. She will do best in a family with a lot of patience and love who are willing to give her time to learn and adjust. With any dog, training and socialization are incredibly important to the success of the dog. Savannah can't wait to meet her new family. Apply today! Savannahs adoption fee was sponsored by Doug Krults and Beth Bauer.

clark.name: Mesa
clark.bio: Mesa is a tendersouled Australian Shepherd weighing 37.6# with a beautiful brown, white, and black tricolor coat and an even more beautiful heart. Mesa came to CCHS as a surrender due to too many animals in the home. Shes shy at first, taking her time to feel safe, but once she trusts you, she melts into affection and soaks up every bit of love offered. Mesa is looking for someone patient, gentle, and kind someone who understands that the best bonds are the ones built slowly. With time, shell become the loyal friend and devoted partner shes meant to be. Come win her heart over and apply today!

clark.name: Freedom
clark.bio: Meet Freedom, a radiant soul bursting with potential! He's one of 10 friends from Ridglan Farms, now ready to unlock his true purpose: being a cherished companion! With every interaction, his confidence grows, and we know he'll thrive in a loving environment. He is 2 years old (estimated DOB 5/26/24) and currently weighs 23.8#. Will you be the one to set his spirit free? Apply for Freedom today!

clark.name: Alex Trebek
clark.breed: Australian Cattle Dog / Blue Heeler & Border Collie.
clark.bio: Meet Alex Trebek. Alex Trebek came to us as a surrender with his 4 other littermates. He has reddish/orange fur with bits of white mixed in. He is 9 weeks old (estimated DOB 4/2/26) and currently weighs 11.9#. Alex is the smartest contestant in the room... and possibly the cutest! This little guy may start off shy, but once he feels safe his playful side really starts to shine. Alex is learning that people can be kind and gentle, cuddles are actually pretty great, and toys are meant to be played with full enthusiasm. Like any young puppy, he is still trying to figure out the world one step at a time and would thrive in a home with a patient family ready to help him build confidence, trust, and lots of happy memories. Bonus points if you answer in the form of belly rubs! Apply for Alex Trebek today!

clark.name: Mercedes
clark.bio: Meet Mercedes. A sleek, and stunning Siamese beauty with elegance worthy of her name. with her striking Blue eyes, soft coat, and graceful personality Mercedes is sure to turn heads wherever she goes. She's the kind of cat who that can be both regal and affectionate, happy to lounge nearby like the queen of the house, but always ready for some gentle love and attention from her favorite people. curious, clever, and full of charm she really has it all! Mercedes would love a home where she can relax, be adored, and show off her gorgeous Siamese personality. So if you are looking for a beautiful companion, and perhaps a bit of sass, Mercedes is ready to drive off into the night with your heart.

clark.name: Helen (Adoption fee Sponsored)
clark.bio: Meet Helen, proof that resilience comes in the sweetest package. Helen is a remarkable 4-year-old cattle dog/red heeler with a heart full of love. Though she is blind and has a heart murmur, she doesn't let her challenges define her. Helen's loving spirit shines brighter than any obstacle. Helen is kind, gentle, and eager to form a close bond with someone willing to open their heart to a special-needs dog. Helen is incredibly sweet, gentle, and affectionate. She is looking for a special family willing to give her the patience, understanding, and care she deserves. Helen may need a little extra care, but she has a lot of extra love to give. At 4 years old, she's a sweet and gentle companion who navigates life with courage and trust. She's searching for a family that will see beyond her disabilities and appreciate the amazing dog she truly is. Helens adoption fee is sponsored by Bailey Fox!

clark.name: Barnett
clark.bio: Barnett is a sweet, spunky girl with a whole lot of personality packed into one adorable puppy. She loves to play, explore, and keep everyone entertained with her puppy antics. Her tail seems to wag nonstop, especially when she's getting attention from people she loves. Barnett is looking for a family that will help her grow into the amazing dog she's destined to become while giving her all the love, adventures, and belly rubs she deserves.

clark.name: Alfie
clark.bio: Meet Alfie! This handsome young guy came to us as a stray, and while his journey hasn't been the easiest, he's proving just how resilient he is. Alfie recently underwent hip surgery and is recovering well, but he'll need a family that understands his ongoing needs and is willing to give him the time and support he deserves. Don't let that fool you into thinking he's fragile, though Alfie's favorite thing in the world is people! He loves attention, affection, and being the center of your universe. Whether he's soaking up pets, following you around, or curling up nearby, Alfie is happiest when he's with his humans. If you're looking for a loving companion and have room in your heart for a special cat who's ready for a fresh start, Alfie may be the perfect match. Apply for Alfie today!

clark.name: Matthews
clark.bio: Mathews is equal parts playful, lovable, and entertaining. This happy pup greets the world with a wagging tail and a joyful spirit that is impossible to resist. He loves people, enjoys making new friends, and is always ready for the next game or cuddle session. With his affectionate nature and fun-loving attitude, Mathews is sure to bring plenty of smiles to his future family.

clark.name: Parrot
clark.bio: Meet Parrot! He is a sweet, playful puppy who came to us with his siblings. While all of his brothers and sisters have found their forever homes, Parrot is still waiting for his turn. Due to an injury he had when he arrived, he had to stay behind and continue his recovery. While he's doing great, his injury will likely require some attention and care in the future. Don't let that fool you, though Parrot is still very much a puppy! He loves to play, explore, and soak up all the affection he can get. This happy little guy has a big heart and an even bigger personality, and he's ready to bring endless smiles to a family willing to give him the love and support he deserves. Parrot has watched all his siblings leave for their new adventures. Now it's his turn to find a forever home where he can continue to grow, play, and be cherished.

clark.name: Bessie
clark.bio: Bessie is a bright, fluffy poodle mix with a playful spark and an eager-to-please attitude. She's clever, social, and always seems ready for whatever the day brings—whether that's a walk, a game, or just hanging out with her favorite people. True to her poodle roots, Bessie is quick to learn and loves positive attention. She would do well in a home that keeps her mentally engaged and offers plenty of opportunities to interact, explore, and bond. She's the kind of dog who will happily be your sidekick through everyday life. Bessies mix of brains and sweetness makes her an easy dog to fall for—she's ready to bring joy, laughter, and a little bit of fluff to her future family.

clark.name: Jacob
clark.bio: Jacob is Edwards more socially curious but still slightly confused about life Shepherd/Pug mix counterpart. Hes got a goofy, expressive face and a personality that bounces somewhere between cautious explorer and accidental comedian. He's still building confidence, but you can see his shepherd brain trying to do serious dog things while his pug side insists on making it weird. Its honestly part of his charm. Jacob does best with gentle encouragement, predictable routines, and a home that understands that bravery isn't instant- it's built. Once comfortable, he shows sweet affection and will happily stick close to his favorite people.

clark.name: Edward
clark.bio: Edward is a one-of-a-kind Shepherd/Pug mix who proves genetics sometimes just hit randomize. He's got the loyal, watchful heart of a shepherd wrapped up in a compact, slightly scruffy little body that absolutely did not get the memo. Edward is still figuring out the world and can be a bit unsure in new situations, but once he trusts you, he leans in hard for comfort and reassurance. He wants to be close to his people and takes his shadow job very seriously. Hes looking for a calm, patient home that will let him bloom at his own pace. Edward isnt the flashy, outgoing type; he's the quiet, soulful companion who will choose you once hes ready, and that bond will be solid.

clark.name: Bindi (Bonded with Terri)
clark.bio: Bindi is a sweet and playful kitten who is ready to take on the world one adventure at a time. She loves exploring new places, chasing toys, and keeping up with all the exciting things happening around her. When she's finished playing, Bindi enjoys curling up in a cozy spot for a well-earned nap. She's looking for a family that will give her plenty of love, attention, and opportunities to let her curious spirit shine.

adams.name: Pika
adams.bio: The first thing people notice about Pika is that she is a senior cat, but once you meet her and she has warmed up to you, you'd never believe it.This sweet girl has had a rough life so far and she wears her fear in her gaze. She takes a fair bit to warm up, but she is learning what love is every day. She still gets scared and is easily overstimulated, so she would need someone patient and calm who will not overwhelm her as she continues to open up.She enjoys gentle belly rubs, pets on her head and shoulders (NOT her rump!), and being spoken to with soothing words of encouragement. She will give affectionate headbutts and even enjoys the rare kiss on her noggin.She is known to lash out when startled, overwhelmed, or overstimulated, but is otherwise a very gentle sweetheart. She just needs someone who will respect her peace as she overcomes years of trauma and learns how to trust. Is that somebody you?Less

adams.name: Magnus
adams.bio: Hi, I'm Magnus! I'm a 5-year-old Jack Russell Terrier mix with a striking white and black coat, and I'm already neutered and ready to go home with you. I'm friendly, gentle, and learning to walk well on a leash. I come as part of a bonded pair with my shy friend Ziggy, so you'll get double the love and companionship! I would do best in an adult-only home where I can thrive and help Ziggy work on his confidence. Come meet us and discover why we're the perfect package for you!

adams.name: Clay
adams.bio: Hi, I'm Clay! I'm a three-month-old black kitten with a striking white mark right on my chest — I'm still tiny at just over three pounds, but my personality is already huge! I'm affectionate and friendly, and I love to play, so I'm ready to bring joy and entertainment to your home. I'm already neutered and get along great with other cats, so I'm a perfect fit for a multi-cat household or as your sole furry companion.

adams.name: Jimmy
adams.bio: Meet Jimmy, a dapper little tuxedo guy with big energy packed into a 1-pound frame! At just two months old, this adventurous kitten is already showing all the signs of being a smart, playful troublemaker — the kind who'll keep you entertained with his mischievous antics. He's already neutered and gets along great with other cats, so he's ready to join a multi-cat household or become your spirited sidekick. Jimmy's adoption fee is $110, and trust me, this energetic bundle of joy is worth every penny. Come meet this charming little tuxedo boy and watch him steal your heart!

adams.name: Polly
adams.bio: Hi, I'm Polly! I'm a tiny tuxedo kitten with extra-special paws — I'm polydactyl, which means I have a few bonus toes that make me one-of-a-kind. At just 2 months old, I'm already spayed and ready to bring big personality to your home. I'm affectionate and full of kitten energy, so I'll keep you entertained as I explore my new world. I would love to go into a home with an existing kitty or alongside one of the other amazing kittens in the shelter!

adams.name: Ziggy
adams.bio: I'm Ziggy, a 3-year-old brown and white Jack Russell Terrier mix, and I'm a gentle soul who takes a little time to warm up to new people. I'm already neutered, so I'm ready to start fresh with you. I'm bonded with my shelter friend Magnus and we'd love to stay together — we're a package deal! I do best in a calm, adult-only home where I can build confidence at my own pace. If you're patient and kind, I promise I'll show you just how loyal and loving I can be.

adams.name: Fjord
adams.bio: Would do best in a home with another cat or adopted alongside another kitten.

adams.name: Molly
adams.bio: Would do best in a home with another cat or adopted alongside another kitten.

adams.name: Caleb
adams.bio: Hi, I'm Caleb — a playful little black kitten with a tiny white spot on my chest that makes me extra special! At just 3 months old, I'm already neutered and ready to bring all my affection and cuddles into your home. I'm friendly and love the company of other cats, so I'd fit right into a multi-cat household.

nlpac.bio: Mac is a male Retriever mix.

fetch.name: Gretzky
fetch.bio: Ello again...In case you forgot, I'm Gretzky. I've been in foster care for a long time now and I've really got a good schedule down. I'll tell you about it if you want....First I wake up and am excited to go potty outside. It's one of my favorite times and I may bark or nip your butt with excitement. Don't worry, I'm not /that/ excited. I just really have to pee.Then I come inside and lay on my beddy. It's my favorite spot. Unfortunately, I'm what my foster calls 'a babe magnet.' This means my canine and feline roommates will come to snuggle in my beddy with me, even in very warm temperatures. I don't understand it either. So we spend the next several hours rotating beddies until lunch, when we go back outside.Much sleeping is had. And snacks.Then the garage door opens and my room mates and I loose our collective minds because foster M'mam is home! I love her.And it means we get to do the best thing ever: walkies. I love pooping when I'm on a leash. I love walking. I don't need to smell anything, I don't care. I just like to walk. Especially in the woods!Sometimes we will see people on our walk. It makes me very nervous. Sometimes they will ask to pet me. I tell them 'No Thank You' by desperately trying to get away from them. Then I am edgy the rest of the walk. What if they secretly pop out of a bush to pet me?? Sometimes my foster M'mam will lock me in the bathroom and pet me. I've gotten used to this strange habit, but I don't really like it.Then, after food smells (someti

fetch.name: Bluey
fetch.bio: The best way to describe Bluey is a TON of fun packed into a 22 lb package. This little peanut is a high energy girl who loves life and lives it to the fullest. Bluey loves other dogs and would do best in a hone with a fur sibling who loves a good wrestling match, game of chase or tug of war. Bluey is small, mighty and fiesty so any fur sibling will have to be good with her being in their face, egging them on to play. Bluey is shy to warm up to new people but rest assured, she loves her foster humans and comes happily running when called, all excited to get loving from her humans. Shes ok with car rides, is good with the resident cat and was good with her foster parents young nephews when they visited. Shes house trained, kennel trained and walks fine on a leash. Her favorite foods are peanut butter and broccoli and she loves a good chew bone. If your looking for a pint size, fun loving pup, Bluey might just be the girl for you!You can apply for this pup at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Caesar
fetch.bio: **COURTESY POST**Meet Caesar! Caesar is a big, lovable boy with an even bigger heart. This handsome Mastiff/Great Dane/Lab/Pit mix tips the scales at 88 lbs — but don’t let his size fool you. He’s a gentle giant who gets along beautifully with kids, dogs, cats, and people of all kinds.Caesar comes fully ready for his forever home: neutered, up-to-date on all vaccinations (including kennel cough), house trained, and crate trained. No medical or behavioral concerns — just a sweet, well-rounded pup looking for someone to love.He’s got a moderate-to-high energy level, so he’d thrive with a family that enjoys walks, playtime, or just an active lifestyle. He does tend to be a little cautious around men at first, but with patience and consistency, he warms right up. He just wants to know he’s safe — and once he does, he’ll be your most loyal companion.If you’re looking for a big, beautiful, good-natured dog who fits right into family life, Caesar might just be your perfect match. Apply today — we have a feeling it’ll be love at first sight. You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Reggie (10)
fetch.bio: Hey everyone, my name is Reggie. Yep, I’m one of the beagles rescued from a medical testing facility, but I don’t want you to adopt me because you feel sorry for me. I want you to adopt me because you understand that I’m not looking backward anymore—I’m starting over.Will I come with some obstacles to overcome? Absolutely. But honestly, who doesn’t?I’m a very smart, inquisitive guy who loves learning new things. I’m also pretty food motivated, which makes training fun for both of us. I’m a sensitive soul who needs time, love and patience. I need someone who won’t give up on me during the hard days, the hard weeks, or even the hard months. All I want is a family that will love me forever. Now about those obstacles. Because I grew up in kennel in that place, and so did my mom, I never learned how to be a dog in a world I didn't know existed. While my foster mom says I’m making great progress I will still need some help with stuff like potty training, (Although my foster mom says I’m doing very good so far) some separation anxiety and wanting to keep all my bones and toys to myself. Oh, and because growing up in a Kennel wasn't any fun, I really have no desire to ever hang out in one again and I will be sure let you know if you try. My foster mom lets me hang out in her office with a gate in the door and while I’m still not a huge fan, its better than a kennel. My foster mom said it took me about a week to get over a lot of the stress of moving in with her family. After a while

fetch.name: Fortune
fetch.bio: As Fortune approaches two years in foster care, everyone who knows him is asking the same question: How has this wonderful boy not been adopted yet?Fortune is a sweet, gentle Great Pyrenees mix who's simply looking for a patient family willing to give him the time he needs to feel safe. Once he trusts you, you'll have one of the most loyal companions you could ask for.Fortune is truly an easy dog to live with. He's fully potty trained, dog-door trained, and non-destructive when left home alone. He settles into a routine beautifully and asks for very little—just a safe place, a little patience, and someone to love.One of Fortune's favorite activities is going for walks, and he's an absolute gentleman on a leash. He also loves car rides, making him the perfect road trip companion. At home, you'll often find him relaxing in the sunshine or happily patrolling the yard, always keeping an eye out for squirrels, rabbits, and other critters. When he feels safe, he loves to run and explore, so a securely fenced yard is required.Fortune enjoys being brushed, does well during baths, and settles nicely in his kennel. With his low-to-medium energy level, he's just as happy lounging around the house as he is exploring the backyard.Fortune is shy, especially around men, and needs adopters who understand that trust takes time. He'll thrive with a family that allows him to adjust at his own pace and celebrates the little victories along the way. Watching him gain confidence is incredibly rewa

fetch.name: Turbo
fetch.bio: Hi, I'm Turbo, but don't let the name fool you! I'm currently accepting applications for the position of 'Permanent Human Companion'. My qualifications include: expert-level napping skills (especially on the couch), a strong work ethic when it comes to belly rubs, and a proven ability to make you laugh with my dramatic snorts and dramatic sighs. Dislikes include: sudden loud noises, riding in the car, being left out of the snack loop, and having my naps interrupted. Strengths: cuddles, loyalty, and a healthy appreciation for naps. I'm looking for a home with a comfy couch, a reliable source of treats, and a human who understands that sometimes, a dog just needs to be left alone (to nap, of course)."You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Harley (23)
fetch.bio: Oh my, this is a big world that I had no idea even existed outside of those walls. Since being out, I've been experiencing so many new things; sounds, smells, human interaction! (Oh, uh, I'm Harley by the way.)So far, I've discovered that I really enjoy the presence of other dogs, don't mind rides in the car, and that all humans aren't that bad after all. In fact, I'm so curious what my foster humans are doing, that I like to be their shadow. Though I'm still not at 100%, house training isn't going so bad. I'm gradually getting there! When going for walks on the leash I sometimes have my moments where I stop and freeze. I don't know if it's out of fear, confusion, or if I just need a minute to take things in. But I need my new humans to understand that I am still navigating this huge change after all. In fact, I typically present as shy when you first meet me, which is why I think no one has really fallen hard for me yet. But, after some time together, we'll grow that bond. I just need some time. Don't get me wrong, I do enjoy playing too once I warm up to you and the other dogs in the home!I want to be transparent though as I'd prefer that my forever family completely understands that this transition will likely be hard. When you initially go to attach my leash, I get a little nervous. When you close the door to my crate, I start feeling all sorts of emotions, which makes me paw at the door and bark a bit -this comes and goes, but I do eventually settle. However, when I'm no

fetch.name: Sid
fetch.bio: Hello! My name is Sid and I'm currently in the market for a new best friend!! I love cuddles and hanging out with my people while we go on fun adventures. If it were up to me I would be glued to your side all the time.... However, I know that's not always possible, so when needed I'm perfectly happy to chill on my own in my kennel. I may be a bit picky about dog friends but I sure do love hanging out with people!In addition to cuddles and following you around the house, I also enjoy going on lots of outdoor adventures! Running around in the snow and going for long hikes are the best!! I also like playing training/mental stimulation games to wear me out when the weather doesn't allow for a lot of time outside. I learn fast and am eager to please my people, I just need a patient and gentle friend to teach me.So if you're also in the market for a new best friend to go on adventures with and then cuddle up with at the end of the day then I'm your guy and you should apply to adopt me today!!You can apply for me at: https://www.fetchfosterandrescue.com/adopt

fetch.name: Pops
fetch.bio: It’s true what they say about the smallest things taking up the most space in your heart. Meet Popsicle aka Pops, a tiny little Yorkie with the spirit of a fighter & a soft spot for his human. Leaving behind the life of a breeder “stud”, Pops arrived in pretty rough condition: a nasty double ear infection, weepy eyes, wounds all over his little head & ears, 3 wiggly teeth & a fractured jaw that was discovered by our Veterinarian after intake.Despite his past, Pops is the most loving little guy.
